hits.hook: Over-guide vs under-guide the AI: managing that balance is the #0 skill he hires for.
hits.text:
There’ll be times where you over-guide the AI. It knows better than you and is more intelligent than you.

There’ll be times where you under-guide the AI. It can go off-track, have the wrong biases, or miss context.

How well you manage this superpower is the #0 skill I look for.

hits.draft_en:
i run small side businesses from amsterdam where ai bots do most of the work.

the skill isn't prompting. it's knowing where the bot stops:

→ drafts: bot
→ sending: my yes
→ money: my yes
→ api keys: never in the chat

over-guide and you're the bottleneck. under-guide and you're the incident.
